title: Read by label with loc
summary: loc selects using row and column labels. This table has default row labels 0, 1 and 2.
introduction: loc selects using row and column labels. This table has default row labels 0, 1 and 2. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.text: loc selects using row and column labels. This table has default row labels 0, 1 and 2.

blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Asha", "Ben", "Cara"],
    "score": [8, 6, 9],
    "team": ["red", "blue", "red"]
})

print(df.loc[1, "name"])
blocks.title: Read by label with loc

blocks.text: The output is Ben. The row label is 1 and the column label is name.
